'''Marlos Catos''' is a [[human]] located in [[Booty Bay]] in the [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. Along with [[K'ron Tusk]], he is the co-founder of the [[Shell Co.|Shell Co. Trading Company]] and creator of the [[Shellcoin]] alternative currency. Originally located in [[Stormwind City]], Catos' offices were forced to relocate from the [[Dwarven District]] to a house along the [[Canals (Stormwind City)|Canals]], before being forced to close by order of [[Highlord Bolvar Fordragon]] and the [[House of Nobles]] and moving out of the city to [[Booty Bay]].
